subject: Shortfall mitigation: temporary rate uplift & launch traffic forecast
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@fastcommerce.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch runway question (FastCommerce)

Hey Rachel — quick heads up. Our product team just confirmed the feature launch window: traffic is expected to ramp quickly for the first 72 hours. We ran an internal sim and expect ~2.2M token-requests/day at peak across a mix of short chat completions and embeddings for search tuning.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily bump rate limits (per-minute request rate and token throughput) for the first 3 days?
- Can you confirm what telemetry you can surface during the surge (per-route latency/cost breakdown)?

We want to avoid throttles for customers in the pilot and are willing to sign a one-week surge commitment. I've attached our forecast sheet.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Launch Ops, FastCommerce
launch-ops@fastcommerce.com

Attachments: fc_launch_traffic_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Launch runway question (FastCommerce) — need quick ops + product decision

Forwarding Alex's ask — fast-moving pilot, wants temporary uplift for first 72 hours. Key points we need to answer asap:
- Feasible uplift envelope (tokens/sec and requests/min) without breaking other SLOs
- Telemetry surface during surge (dashboard + per-route sampling)
- Risk / fallback (auto-fallback to a lower-latency model or regional reroute)

Proposed immediate response to customer: propose a scoped uplift (3x request rate, 2x token throughput) with a hard cap and automatic rollback after 72h. Ben — can you validate whether 3x/2x is safe for their plan and estimate expected cost delta? Grace — product: any constraints on instrumenting per-route traces quickly? Karthik — if we greenlight, sales needs the precise wording we can commit to for the mutual action plan.

I attached the customer sheet and a draft temporary rate change form. I'll schedule a 30-min sync if needed. I want to respond today.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: fc_launch_traffic_estimate.xlsx, temporary_rate_change_form.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch runway question (FastCommerce) — need quick ops + product decision

Short answer: technically possible but with caveats. Notes from infra review:

- Current baseline for FastCommerce: 700k token-requests/day (historic). Their forecast (~2.2M/day peak) represents ~3.1x token volume and ~3.5x request rate during peak windows.
- Cluster headroom: in us-west-2 we have soft headroom for short bursts up to ~3.5x per-customer RPS if we apply temporary local throttling elsewhere and shift routing. This will add CPU pressure and increase cold KV-cache thrashing risk.
- Safe envelope: 3x request rate and 2.5x token throughput is my recommended max for a 72-hour window if we enable aggressive batching and prefix KV caching. Anything beyond that risks increased tail latency and a higher probability of circuit-breaking.
- Cost delta estimate (rough): incremental infra + burst licensing ~ $2.8k/day on our side; customer-facing unit-cost increase estimate we should discuss with pricing.

Action items for product/ops:
- Enable temporary per-customer rate profile with auto-rollback at 72h (requires a change in the routing policy config; I can stage this in a maintenance window).
- Turn on per-route trace sampling at 10% for the duration + expose a short-lived dashboard link.

I'll draft the exact numbers we can promise in the SAP (service adjustment form).

— Ben
Ben Carter
Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch runway question (FastCommerce) — need quick ops + product decision

Agree with Ben's envelope. Product asks / constraints:

- We can support a 72-hour temporary uplift at 3x request-rate / 2.5x token throughput with these guardrails:
  - Rolling canary for first 2 hours (25% traffic) then expand to 100% if stable.
  - Automatic fallback rule: if tail p95 latency > 850ms for 5 consecutive minutes, rollback to baseline and trigger alert.
  - KV prefix caching enabled and pre-warm keys provided by customer (FastCommerce should share top 500 prefixes).

- Telemetry: we will provision a short-lived dashboard showing: per-route RPS, p50/p95 latency, token-per-request histogram, and cost-per-token estimate. Link will be active for the 7-day window.

Karthik — sales language: we can offer the uplift as a one-week surge addendum: 72h elevated-rate window with automatic rollback and explicit cost-sharing to cover burst infra. Ben, please attach the SAP with numbers; Rachel, use the wording below for customer-facing commitment.

Suggested customer message (short):
"Redwood can provision a temporary surge profile for your launch: up to 3x request rate and 2.5x token throughput for a 72-hour window. We will perform a 2-hour canary and provide a monitoring dashboard. If latency exceeds the agreed threshold, we will automatically rollback. We propose a shared surge-cost model; details attached."

I'll coordinate the monitoring link and the rollback policy.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product — Platform
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch runway question (FastCommerce) — need quick ops + product decision

Thanks all. Sales commitment: I'll send FastCommerce the addendum language this afternoon with the pricing split. Quick notes for the customer-facing commitment:
- Commitment window: 72 hours elevated rate; monitoring dashboard for 7 days.
- Envelope: up to 3x request-rate / 2.5x token throughput; automatic rollback on p95 > 850ms for 5m.
- Cost: pass-through of incremental burst infra + a $2,500/day handling fee (we can discount to $1,750/day if they sign a 3-month reserved capacity).

Rachel — please confirm you have the attachments and the HubSpot link in the reply to Alex. I'll copy CS and Legal if they accept.

— Karthik
